2609.10397.title: Retrofitting Code Using LLMs to Support Exceptional Behavior
2609.10397.paper_summary: Exception Related Code (ERC), which includes throw statements, conditions (if statements) that guard those throw statements, and try/catch blocks, is an essential component of software systems, allowing developers to detect and handle exceptional states that deviate from the expected program behavior. However, manually writing ERC across large codebases is tedious. We propose a novel task: retrofitting existing code with ERC. Namely, given code (without ERC) and Exceptional Behavior Tests (EBTs) (e.g., check if method throws InvalidArgumentException if null is given as the value to the argument) we aim to automatically generate missing ERC, such that the given tests pass. We design and implement Exception Coder (EXCODER) that performs context engineering to help Large Language Models (LLMs) tackle this task. EXCODER integrates static and dynamic program analysis with LLMs by providing the extracted contextual information to the LLMs. To evaluate EXCODER, we build a benchmark constructed from GitHub Java repositories, where we systematically remove ERC in 304 methods from 75 projects. Our results demonstrate that EXCODER provides an effective, though imperfect, solution to this problem in automated code generation, offering developers the first way to implement ERC following test-driven development. When combined with Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b, EXCODER achieves pass@1, 5, and 10 rates of 85.92% (12.56 percentage points over baseline), 86.18% (12.82 p.p. over baseline), and 86.51% (13.15 p.p. over baseline), respectively, on developer-written test suites. Our manual inspection of the generated code further reveals limitations of EXCODER, pointing to directions for future work.
2609.10397.paper_summary_zh: 例外相關代碼（ERC），包括拋出語句、保護這些拋出語句的條件（如果語句）和嘗試/捕獲區塊，是軟體系統的重要組成部分，使開發人員能夠檢測和處理偏離預期程式行為的例外狀態。然而，在大型代碼庫中手動編寫ERC是繁瑣的。我們提出了一個新任務：為現有代碼添加ERC。具體來說，給定沒有ERC的代碼和例外行為測試（EBTs）（例如，檢查如果將null作為參數的值傳遞時，方法是否拋出InvalidArgumentException），我們的目標是自動生成缺失的ERC，以使給定的測試通過。我們設計並實現了例外編碼器（EXCODER），它執行上下文工程以幫助大型語言模型（LLMs）處理這一任務。EXCODER通過向LLMs提供提取的上下文信息，將靜態和動態程式分析與LLMs整合在一起。為了評估EXCODER，我們建立了一個基準，該基準由GitHub Java存儲庫構成，我們系統地從75個項目的304個方法中刪除了ERC。我們的結果表明，EXCODER為自動代碼生成的這一問題提供了一個有效但不完美的解決方案，為開發人員提供了遵循測試驅動開發實現ERC的首個方法。當與Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b結合時，EXCODER在開發人員編寫的測試套件上達到了85.92%（比基準高出12.56個百分點）、86.18%（比基準高出12.82個百分點）和86.51%（比基準高出13.15個百分點）的通過率。對生成代碼的手動檢查進一步揭示了EXCODER的局限性，指向未來工作的方向。
